newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight fixings and orders routine.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight fixings and orders routine.

text.p: Brokers reported a few new fixtures and orders in the sugar freight market on Wednesday.
Fixtures - Seven Seas booked 14,000 bagged N.Brazil to Med Nov 15/22.
CSR 18,000 bulk Queensland to Japan Nov 20/30 on subjects at just above $19.
Jean Lion 14,000 bagged prompt N.Brazil to Algeria or Black Sea in the low $30 basis Algeria.
E.D and F.Man 25,000 bulk Maceio to Black Sea or Casablanca Nov 10/15.
Orders - Man 12,000 bagged prompt India to Indonesia 14,000/15,000 bulk Puerto Quetzal to Black Sea or Algeria Nov 20/25.
Man 6,000 prompt from Recife to W.Africa.
Dreyfus 14,700 bagged Continent to Tunisia nov 20/25.
